scene: 公司门头 / 建筑外立面标牌 (Outdoor Facade & Entrance Doorhead)
prompt_en: Commercial architecture photography, modern headquarters entrance facade for '开思 KAISI', minimalist dark titanium zinc cladding wall, 3D dimensional halo-lit backlit logo sign emitting elegant brand glow (#0070F0 and warm white 4000K), tempered glass canopy, luxury polished terrazzo floor with subtle reflections, architectural lighting, dusk twilight atmosphere, ultra-realistic, architectural digest, shot on Hasselblad H6D-100c, 8k resolution, photorealistic --ar 16:9 --style raw --v 6.0
prompt_zh: 建筑摄影，'开思 KAISI' 现代化企业总部大楼门头入口外立面，极简深色钛锌板幕墙，3D金属背发光品牌标志（发光色为品牌主色 #0070F0 搭配4000K暖白自然光），钢化玻璃雨棚，镜面水磨石地面倒影，黄昏暮色建筑照明，超高精细节，8K分辨率
materials: 深灰色氟碳喷涂铝单板、304精工拉丝不锈钢字壳、进口亚克力背发光底板、防水LED模组
lighting_specs: 色温 4000K 自然白光，发光均匀无暗斑，夜间照度 150-200 Lux

scene: 前台接待区形象墙 (Corporate Reception Desk & 3D Logo Wall)
prompt_en: Corporate interior design photography, reception lobby of '开思 KAISI', luxury Calacatta marble front desk, feature accent background wall made of fluted acoustic oak wood panels and matte slate, floating 3D brushed brass and crystal acrylic corporate logo of '开思 KAISI' with recessed warm LED perimeter backlighting (#0070F0 accents), clean ambient daylight, minimalist potted ficus bonsai, Architectural Digest interior style, raytracing, photorealistic, 8k --ar 16:9 --v 6.0
prompt_zh: 企业室内设计摄影，'开思 KAISI' 前台接待大厅，高端鱼肚白大理石前台接待桌，背景形象墙采用木质吸音格栅与哑光岩板拼接，悬浮式3D拉丝金属立体Logo标牌，内嵌柔和背光（融入品牌辅色 #F88C10），通透极简，8K超清画质
materials: 意大利天然大理石/岩板、实木格栅吸音板、高精度金属电镀立体字、3M反光膜
installation: Logo中心水平线严格对齐人眼视觉黄金高度 1500mm，左右居中留白不小于0.5X

scene: 走廊企业文化墙 (Office Corridor & Brand Culture Wall)
prompt_en: Modern open office hallway corridor, corporate culture feature wall for '开思 KAISI', modular magnetic acrylic display panels showing company vision, core milestones, and global team achievements, brand primary color accents (#0070F0), warm ceiling linear recessed spotlights, polished concrete flooring, glass conference room partitions in background, depth of field, corporate identity showcase, 8k, photorealistic --ar 16:9 --v 6.0
prompt_zh: 现代化企业走廊过道，'开思 KAISI' 企业文化展示墙，模块化亚克力与磁吸展板，展示使命愿景价值观与全球发展历程时间轴，融入品牌主题色 #0070F0 与 #F0B000，嵌入式线性射灯照明，自流平地面倒影，大景深，8K超清
structure: 三层模块化结构：上层企业愿景Slogan（金属字），中层磁吸荣誉与里程碑，下层员工心声与团队动态

scene: 智能会议室与磨砂玻璃腰线 (Conference Room with Frosted Film & Smart Table)
prompt_en: High-tech executive board meeting room, floor-to-ceiling smart acoustic glass partitions featuring custom frosted privacy film with translucent cut-out logo pattern of '开思 KAISI' and subtle color accent lines (#0070F0), long walnut conference table with embedded wireless charging pads, Herman Miller ergonomic chairs, dual 85-inch teleconference displays, city skyline view outside window, corporate realism, 8k --ar 16:9 --v 6.0
prompt_zh: 高科技高管董事会议室，落地隔音玻璃隔断上贴有专属定制防撞磨砂隐私腰线，镂空展示 '开思 KAISI' 标志图案与品牌细线，胡桃木实木会议桌，人体工学椅，双85寸视频会议大屏，窗外城市天际线，8K实景渲染
specs: 磨砂腰线高度 200mm，贴附中心线距离地面 1200mm，透光率 65%，上下各留 2mm 品牌色彩透明导向槽

scene: 培训室与多功能厅 (Training Room & Auditorium)
prompt_en: Tiered corporate auditorium and training lecture hall, modern stage with a minimalist wooden lectern podium branded with crisp '开思 KAISI' logo plaque, huge seamless 4K LED backdrop screen displaying presentation keynote slide in brand palette (#0070F0 and #F88C10), rows of comfortable theater seating with fold-out desks, professional acoustic fabric wall panels, warm stage spotlights, photorealistic, 8k --ar 16:9 --v 6.0

av_guideline: LED大屏待机画面强制采用 3840x2160 分辨率，Logo位于左上角安全区，严禁强眩光纯白全屏

scene: 贵宾接待室 (VIP Executive Reception Lounge)

scene: 全球产品发布会主舞台 (Global Product Launch Keynote Stage)
prompt_en: Epic global product launch keynote event stage, massive 32:9 curved giant LED screen glowing with futuristic visual key visual of '开思 KAISI' in radiant electric brand colors (#0070F0, #F88C10), dramatic concert-grade laser beams and atmospheric haze, glossy black reflective stage floor, charismatic presenter standing center stage holding clicker, auditorium packed with audience holding smartphones, Apple keynote level production, 8k --ar 16:9 --v 6.0
